title: Minimum Value to Get Positive Step by Step Sum
summary: Given an array of integers, determine the smallest positive initial value such that the cumulative sum, starting from this value and adding each array element in sequence, never falls below 1.
statement: Given an array of integers, determine the smallest positive initial value such that the cumulative sum, starting from this value and adding each array element in sequence, never falls below 1.
constraints: Choose the smallest positive start value so every running total stays at least one.
nums may contain positive and negative integers.
hints: Compute prefix sums assuming a zero start.
Record the minimum prefix, including the empty prefix zero.
The chosen start must be at least one minus that minimum.
This value makes the lowest adjusted prefix exactly one and any smaller value fail there.
editorial: This value makes the lowest adjusted prefix exactly one and any smaller value fail there.
